info.title: Browser Foreman
info.description: The local API of Browser Foreman. Every route except health, version, this document and sign-in needs a caller: Authorization: Bearer <token>, or the brofo_session cookie. Writes made with the cookie must send X-CSRF-Token. x-role names the least role a route needs (viewer < editor < owner).
